KOM Sprint (HC) Collado del Alguacil - Cima Albert

story: Wout van Aert and Ivo Oliveira initiated the day’s first attack. A twelve-rider group, driven by Uno-X Mobility, bridged across, while a second group of 54 formed behind. Several riders subsequently reached the front, including Mikel Landa. Sepp Kuss attacked from the peloton and gained several positions in the general classification. On the final climb, Landa broke clear to claim a solo victory. Despite losing time to Felix Gall, Enric Mas secured the overall classification.
